description: F0 discovery catalog: agencies and index portals for open/mixed/request-only wildfire training data (LATAM + Australia + global proxies). Not a claim of pack readiness or measured IoU.

sources.name: Digital Earth Australia Hotspots
sources.license_note: Geoscience Australia / DEA products typically CC-BY; confirm per product page before train
sources.notes: National hotspot viewer/WMS/WFS. Weak labels / timeline only; not final perimeter.

sources.name: DEA Hotspots product page (GA)
sources.license_note: CC-BY style GA terms; cite product
sources.notes: Docs and access notes for DEA Hotspots.

sources.name: NAFI North Australia Fire Information
sources.license_note: Open for research/management use; check NAFI terms for redistribution
sources.notes: Seasonal fire scar GeoTIFF/shapefile downloads; multi-week scars good for ml_weak.

sources.name: NT Fire History (data.nt.gov.au)
sources.license_note: Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY) per portal
sources.notes: NT fire extents validated vs RS; NAFI-linked.

sources.name: NSW NPWS Fire History (SEED)
sources.license_note: NSW open data; check SEED license tag on dataset
sources.notes: Wildfire + prescribed burn final boundaries; multi-year.

sources.name: NSW Fire History listing (data.nsw)
sources.license_note: Same SEED layer via data.nsw
sources.notes: Alternate portal entry for NPWS fire history.

sources.name: ABARES forest fire data
sources.license_note: Australian Government open data; CC attribution typical
sources.notes: National forest fire area tables including Black Summer; not multi-scene EO stacks.

sources.name: National Indicative Aggregated Fire Extent (Black Summer era)
sources.license_note: Australian Government open geospatial; verify portal license
sources.notes: Indicative national fire extent; use as discovery/perimeter proxy.

sources.name: Black Summer wildfires metrics (PANGAEA)
sources.license_note: PANGAEA dataset license on DOI page; cite Levin et al.
sources.notes: 391 large Black Summer fires polygons + ignition points; research pack.

sources.name: Geoscience Australia
sources.license_note: CC-BY for many GA datasets
sources.notes: Portal hub for DEA and national geoscience products.

sources.name: CEMS EMSR500 Wildfire Western Australia (Perth)
sources.license_note: Copernicus EMS open access; EU attribution required; proxy ≠ national cadastre
sources.notes: 2021-02; DEL + MONIT + GRA vector zips. AOI Perth ~116.18,-31.78.

sources.name: CEMS EMSR408 Wildfires NSW Australia
sources.license_note: Copernicus EMS open; proxy perimeter
sources.notes: 2019-11 Black Summer period; many AOIs with multi-MONIT products.

sources.name: INPE BDQueimadas
sources.license_note: INPE public fire focus data; free access; cite INPE Queimadas
sources.notes: Active fire points LatAm; export tools; weak labels.

sources.name: TerraBrasilis (INPE)
sources.license_note: INPE open dissemination
sources.notes: Shapefile/raster downloads for fire and deforestation products.

sources.name: MapBiomas Fogo / Fire
sources.license_note: MapBiomas public open free under CC-BY
sources.notes: Annual/monthly burned scars Brazil; GEE toolkit; still need multi-date S2 for ml_strong.

sources.name: MapBiomas Fire platform
sources.license_note: CC-BY MapBiomas
sources.notes: Interactive burned area totals and downloads.

sources.name: MapBiomas Fire algorithms (GitHub)
sources.license_note: Code license on repo; maps CC-BY
sources.notes: Reproducible classification code; not EO stacks.

sources.name: CONAF Chile
sources.license_note: Operational agency site; perimeter SHP often request/formal
sources.notes: Request perimeter+dates; prefer CEMS proxy until rights written.

sources.name: CEMS EMSR647 Forest Fires Chile 2023
sources.license_note: Copernicus EMS open; proxy
sources.notes: 2023-02; 7 AOIs many MONIT products (~38 products).

sources.name: CEMS EMSR715 Valparaiso Chile 2024
sources.license_note: Copernicus EMS open; proxy
sources.notes: 2024-02 Valparaiso/Viña deadly fires; rapid mapping + recovery EMSN188.

sources.name: CONAFOR Mexico
sources.license_note: Government portal; open datasets vary by product
sources.notes: Agency hub; pair with datos.gob.mx fire tables.

sources.name: CONAFOR incendios forestales (datos.gob.mx)
sources.license_note: Mexican open data libre uso; cite CONAFOR
sources.notes: Historical fire CSV series; often tabular not multi-date EO.

sources.name: CEMS EMSR717 Wildfires Mexico 2024
sources.license_note: Copernicus EMS open; proxy
sources.notes: 2024 Central America season bulletin; Mexico activation.

sources.name: CEMS EMSR726 Wildfires Belize 2024
sources.license_note: Copernicus EMS open
sources.notes: 2024 Central America wildfire activations cluster.

sources.name: CEMS EMSR727 Wildfires Guatemala 2024
sources.license_note: Copernicus EMS open
sources.notes: 2024 Guatemala wildfire delineation.

sources.name: CEMS EMSR765 Wildfire Bolivia 2024
sources.license_note: Copernicus EMS open; proxy
sources.notes: 2024-08 Bolivia activation (JRC catalogue EMSR765).

sources.name: SMN Argentina
sources.license_note: National met service; fire polygons not primary product
sources.notes: Meteo context; pair FIRMS/CEMS for geometry.

sources.name: IDEAM Colombia
sources.license_note: Agency open data varies; often request for detailed fire poly
sources.notes: Prefer FIRMS + any published burned layers.

sources.name: NASA FIRMS
sources.license_note: NASA open data policy; free registration for some bulk downloads
sources.notes: NRT MODIS/VIIRS hotspots; proxy only; not field-validated perimeter.

sources.name: NASA Earthdata FIRMS tool page
sources.license_note: NASA open
sources.notes: Tool overview and access links.

sources.name: Copernicus EMS On Demand Mapping
sources.license_note: Copernicus open access mapping products
sources.notes: Activation search; vector packages per EMSR.

sources.name: CEMS activations list
sources.license_note: Copernicus open
sources.notes: Filter by wildfire / country for F0 hunt.

sources.name: emergency.copernicus.eu
sources.license_note: Copernicus EMS
sources.notes: Service landing; use-cases.

sources.name: GWIS Global Wildfire Information System
sources.license_note: JRC/EFFIS-GWIS public services; cite JRC
sources.notes: Current situation + historical downloads.

sources.name: GWIS data downloads
sources.license_note: JRC open research downloads (MCD64/GlobFire derived)
sources.notes: MCD64A1 CSV + GlobFire perimeters 2002-2024; coarse/pretrain.

sources.name: Element84 Earth Search STAC (Sentinel-2)
sources.license_note: Sentinel-2 Copernicus open; STAC is free API
sources.notes: Pull multi-date S2 for any bbox after perimeter known.

sources.name: Global Forest Watch fires
sources.license_note: Aggregates FIRMS etc.; check GFW terms for bulk
sources.notes: Discovery UI; prefer original FIRMS for provenance.
